posts.title: A Partial Taxonomy of Ontological Hazards
posts.description: I've spent this weekend building monsters for Tunnels & Trolls: A New Age . It's been fun but it's also been a lot . I think I've statted up about 60 bestiary entries in the past 48 hours. This evening, as a palette cleanser, I decided to write more monsters, but this time for Troika . Here they are.
